ignore.reason: Go byte slices, copy, equality and checked native-size conversions represent these storage primitives; wire decoding and encoding still delegate to Core.
Reader.Next uses tlv_reader_next_source_diag to preserve both source spans and diagnostics; these reduced-output wrappers add no separate public operation.
Writer uses tlv_write_element_diag and tlv_tree_writer_begin_diag/end_diag; the no-diagnostic wrappers add no separate public operation.

Callbacks selected by tlv_fixed_format_init for NewFixed; Core invokes them through the format descriptor. The referenced tlv_binary_decode identity check remains counted as a reference, not a separate public operation.

Callbacks installed by the inline tlv_number_codec, tlv_text_codec and tlv_digits_codec constructors used by NumberCodec, TextCodec and DigitsCodec; Go invokes tlv_codec_decode/encode on those descriptors.

Core constructors install these callbacks for NewComposed, NewEscaped and NewVariable. Reader/Writer, Document and Query invoke the resulting descriptors; direct callback APIs would duplicate these operations without Core's wrapper checks.

NewComposed with fixed identifier/length encodings and TagOnly exposes the same generic tagged binary operation through the broader tagged-fields constructor; a second public constructor adds no functionality.
Writer.Measure and WriteElement already expose canonical format measurement and encoding through richer diagnostic wrappers; Format.Preserve separately exposes exact source preservation.
